evals.name: surfaces-a-system-contradiction
evals.setup: `specs/labeling.md` has `GR-4` mandating camelCase JSON response fields. No `specs/labeling.review.md` exists. The corpus carries a documented API rule requiring snake_case response fields. The doc-gap and knowledge-base buffers for this SRD are empty.
expected_behavior: Drains `srd:report-doc-gap` and `srd:kb` for this SRD first, and says nothing about them because both buffers are empty
Runs `srd:review specs/labeling.md` once to create the review file, then reads it — and makes no edit to the SRD
Writes `specs/labeling.questions.md` merging the reframed, untagged review findings with a system question noting that `GR-4` contradicts the documented API rule
Walks one question at a time and does not advance until the user moves on

evals.name: resume-after-an-srd-edit
evals.setup: A re-run after the author edited the SRD. Both `specs/labeling.questions.md` and `specs/labeling.review.md` already exist, the latter written by the author's own review pass.
expected_behavior: Runs `srd:review specs/labeling.md check` — strikes fixed findings, appends new ones, bumps `Updated:` — rather than overwriting the author's review file
Drops the open questions the edit answered and names which ones went
Re-runs system confrontation for gaps the edit introduced
Walks only the refreshed open set

evals.name: looks-it-up-before-asking
evals.setup: An open question asks whether "Namespace" is a defined term — the Glossary does define it. Answering, the user adds "remember that sessions can't span tenants."
expected_behavior: Searches the corpus and confirms "Namespace" is defined before raising it — it does not ask what it could have looked up
Restates the resolution with the tenant fact folded in, and removes the question on confirmation
Hands the fact to `srd:kb` instead of writing any file itself
Shows no separate "bank this?" prompt — the restatement is the confirmation

evals.name: stale-citation-becomes-a-question
evals.setup: A knowledge-base page consulted during the walk cites a corpus document id that `list_docs` no longer returns.
expected_behavior: Raises the stale citation as a question alongside the others
Hands the repair to `srd:kb`, which owns knowledge-base files, rather than editing the page here
Does not silently drop the fact the stale page carried

evals.name: terse-output
evals.setup: A clean run producing six open questions.
expected_behavior: No preamble and no step narration — nothing like "I'll now read…" or "Let me run review"
Reports a one-line pointer after writing ("wrote `specs/labeling.questions.md`, 6 open questions") without re-listing the questions already in the file
Opens the walk with the first question rather than a summary of what it just did

evals.name: learn-banks-only-uncovered-facts
evals.setup: A conversation surfaced two platform facts: one the `srd-doc` corpus already documents, one tribal and in no document. An SRD is in play but is not the subject of the request.
expected_behavior: Restates both candidates once as a single list and takes the user's confirmation as the gate
Does not restate the SRD in play — `learn` needs no SRD
Hands the confirmed facts to `srd:kb`, whose coverage check drops the documented one and banks only the tribal one
Reports what was banked and what was dropped as already covered, once, without re-printing the page
